sites.downstream: Returned category label string from simple_classify()
sites.reason: The model selects one label from a closed set of 10 categories with no generation, reasoning, or extraction. This is a textbook Choice primitive use case.

options.name: fallback
options.action: Jev Choice with confidence-gated fallback to original Anthropic call
options.benefit: Accepted Jev decisions are faster (~100ms) and cheaper (System One pricing vs claude-haiku-4-5). Fallback retains original quality for uncertain cases.
options.risk: Low — conservative posture retains the original path for all uncertain/error cases
options.latency_direction: lower for accepted; serial miss adds Jev latency before original inference
options.cost_direction: lower overall: Jev cost + fallback_fraction * original cost

options.name: jev_only
options.action: Replace Anthropic call entirely with Jev Choice
options.risk: Not available under conservative posture — requires measured parity and aggressive approval

options.name: leave
options.action: No change — keep existing Anthropic call
